title: docs: link E2B's template guide for custom sandbox templates
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: The sandbox guide now explains how to preinstall packages in a custom E2B template: build it in your own E2B account using E2B's template guide, publish it, then start it with `polli sandbox create <project-slug>/<template-name>`.

Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny tool belt and is small-to-medium sized within the scene, sharing the frame with other elements—never oversized or dominating the image, strictly pixel art style, never realistic; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
